g.text: No bot reviews the changes. Type @name to add one.

You type what you want and press Enter.
ELU answers with a Task. You approve it with y.
The agent works in its own Git worktree.
ELU runs the project's checks on the change.
The reply shows. The checks passed. Nothing is pushed.
